mechanism_narrative: A declining federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS declines, SPX 20-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate falls below 0.15%, it indicates aggressive monetary easing that reduces risk-free rates and boosts equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS < 0.15%, SPX 5-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 235 and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) remains below 0.15%, it indicates a policy response to high inflation that leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: high inflation with low policy rates
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL > 235 AND FEDFUNDS < 0.15%, SPX 60-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 5.0%), the S&P 500 exhibits negative forward returns due to recessionary expectations and reduced corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: When UNRATE > 5.0%, SPX 20-day returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts (HOUST) indicate a strengthening economy and increased consumer confidence, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST rises, SPX 5-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 95.0, it signals a weakening economy and reduced corporate profitability, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO < 95.0, SPX 60-day returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When residential sales (RSAFS) exceed 400,000 and housing starts (HOUST) exceed 700, it indicates a robust housing market that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When RSAFS > 400000 AND HOUST > 700, SPX 20-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 230.0), the S&P 500 exhibits negative forward returns due to central bank tightening and reduced risk appetite.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL > 230.0, SPX 60-day returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
